summary: Your need for freedom shows up through other people. You may encounter disruptors, wild cards, or people who won't be contained. Or you become the unpredictable one nobody can pin down.
body: Your need for freedom shows up through other people. You may encounter disruptors, wild cards, or people who won't be contained. Or you become the unpredictable one nobody can pin down. The push-pull between belonging and breaking away plays out in your relationships, where you crave connection and then need to bolt. The work is owning both your independence and your need for people instead of making someone else carry one side. You can be free and still show up.
gift: At your best: independent and connected, free without disappearing.
shadow: The trap: bolting when it gets close, or making others hold the chaos for you.
integration: Let identity and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Suited to independent or innovative work where you aren't boxed in.
do: Own your independence and your need for people
Name the freedom you need out loud
dont: Pick wild cards to feel alive
